# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects any active spell or item from the Essence realm. Caster can
concentrate on a 5'R area each round.
@@ 2
Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the target and adds 5 to all
of the targets RRs versus spells.
@@ 3
As DetectEssence, except realm is Mentalism.
@@ 4
When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of
Essence, the ''incoming'' spell must first make an RR before the caster makes
an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level.
If the ''incoming'' spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this
spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.
Essence Protection remains in effect until it's caster has been the target of
any 1 Essence spell.
@@ 5
As Detect Essence, except realm is Channeling.
@@ 6
As Essence Protection, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
@@ 7
As Detect Essence, except detects invisible things. All attacks against
something so detected are modified by -50.
@@ 8
As Essence Protection, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
@@ 9
As Protection I, except bonuses are 10 and all beings within 10'R oftarget get
the benefits.
@@ 10
Caster becomes aware an instant before anyone within 10' casts a spell. This
should allow enough time to cast any instantaneous spell.
@@ 11
Caster can use up to half of his normal OB with the weapon he has in his hands
to parry an elemental bolt spell.
@@ 12
As Detect Invisible, except also detects things that are Astral, Ethereal, out
of phase, etc.
@@ 13
As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.
@@ 14
As Detect Essence, except detects active spells, magic items, or spell users
of any realm.
@@ 15
As Protection III, except has a 10'R as in Protection Sphere I.
@@ 16
As Spell Detection I, except it detects spells cast within a 20'R and the
caster learns who is casting the spell.
@@ 17
As Protection I, except bonuses are 20.
@@ 18
Caster can add up to half of his normal OB (with the weapon he has in his
hands) to his RR versus any spell that targets him and of which he is aware.
@@ 19
As Essence Protection, except that spells of any realm are affected and it has
a 10'R.
@@ 20
As Protection IV, except has a 10'R as in Protection Sphere II.
@@ 25
As SpellDetection II, except it detects spells cast within a 30'R and the
caster learns what realm they are casting.
@@ 30
As SpellDetection II, except it detects spells cast within 50'R and the caster
leams the exact spell they are casting.
@@ 50
Caster may utilize any one of the lower level spells on this list each round.
